text:
maya: Heads up — I'm prepping a refresh of the quickstart to include a tiny containerized hello-world + first deploy walkthrough. WIP PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321. Posting here for coordination and to catch any auth/snippet nits.

leroy: Looks good. Quick note — Dockerfile needs an explicit ENV example for REDWOOD_API_KEY and a tiny healthcheck. Left a couple inline comments on the PR. :eyes:

samira: Agree with preserving both Python + Node flavors if it's not too much overhead. Most users expect a Node snippet. Could we do a tiny multi-language folder like `/examples/quickstart-python` and `/examples/quickstart-node`?

maya: Yeah we can keep both. For the Dockerfile example I'm planning to show the minimum for running the sample app. Draft snippet I put in the PR:
```Dockerfile
FROM python:3.11-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
ENV REDWOOD_API_KEY=REPLACE_ME
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["python", "app.py"]
```

leroy: Nice. Please also add a line in the quickstart that says: "Set REDWOOD_API_KEY as an env var or use your secrets manager; do not hardcode in production." Small phrasing suggestion in the PR.

evan: FYI CI is currently failing on this branch: docs build error about missing mkdocs theme dependency. I see an error in the logs: `PackageNotFoundError: mkdocs-material` — likely needs an update to docs/requirements.txt or mkdocs.yml. cc @docs-ci-bot.

docs-ci-bot: build status — PR #4321 — ❌ 1 failing check: docs/build. Logs: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/4321/logs

maya: Thanks, Evan. I'll add mkdocs-material to docs/requirements.txt and push. Also will update the auth snippet to be explicit about SDK version: `@redwood/sdk@^5.0.0` and show example using env var:
```js
// Node snippet for quickstart
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
```

samira: Can you also include a one-liner for local dev with docker run so people can smoke test? e.g. `docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY -p 8080:8080 quickstart-hello`

leroy: I'll take the Node example and add a tiny Dockerfile variant in a follow-up PR (will reference #4321). I'll also add a smoke test snippet in `.github/workflows/docs-smoke.yml` that runs `docker build` and `docker run` for the examples.

maya: Awesome, thanks. Here's a short pre-merge checklist I'm tracking in the PR description: 1) fix mkdocs dependency, 2) add REDWOOD_API_KEY mention + snippet, 3) add Node example or link to follow-up PR, 4) CI smoke test passes, 5) update changelog snippet.

evan: Sounds good. Once CI is green I'll do a quick pass for wording and then we can merge. If you want faster feedback ping me in #eng during the hour after CI completes. :thumbsup:

maya: Will rebase, push the mkdocs fix & Dockerfile tweaks tonight. Plan to merge tomorrow after CI goes green unless major wording changes come up. Thanks all! :shipit:
